cards.meaning: interference; meddling in another's affairs without permission or right
cards.example: Malinaw na panghihimasok ang ginawa ng mga barkong Tsino sa loob ng ating teritoryal na karagatan.
cards.exampleMeaning: What the Chinese ships did inside our territorial waters was clearly interference.
cards.note: Mas may bigat at diplomatic/political na dating ito kaysa sa payak na 'pakikialam' — ginagamit kapag may paglabag sa karapatan o soberanya ng ibang bansa o tao. Karaniwang gamit: panghihimasok sa usaping panloob, panghihimasok ng dayuhang bansa, walang karapatang manghimasok.
cards.tiesTo: China Coast Guard and PLA Navy vessels blocking the Philippine resupply mission to BRP Sierra Madre at Ayungin Shoal

cards.meaning: rising up again; recovery after a fall or setback
cards.example: Biglaang pagbangon ang naranasan ng PSEi matapos ang limang araw na pagbagsak.
cards.exampleMeaning: The PSEi experienced a sudden recovery after five straight days of decline.
cards.note: Karaniwang gamit sa economic at personal na konteksto — may implikasyon ng pagbabalik ng lakas matapos ang isang mahirap na yugto. Iba ito sa payak na 'pagtaas,' na basta pagdami lamang; ang 'pagbangon' ay may kasamang kuwento ng pagkabagsak bago ito. Karaniwang pares: pagbangon ng ekonomiya, pagbangon mula sa kalamidad, pagbangon ng merkado.
cards.tiesTo: PSEi snapping its 5-day losing streak, rebounding 1.67% off a 10-month low

cards.meaning: to shelve, set aside, table an issue — often indefinitely, deliberately, institutionally
cards.example: 台湾问题和芯片管制这次被双方搁置，没有列入公报。
cards.examplePinyin: Táiwān wèntí hé xīnpiàn guǎnzhì zhècì bèi shuāngfāng gēzhì, méiyǒu lièrù gōngbào.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Taiwan issue and chip controls were shelved by both sides this time, and weren't included in the communiqué.
cards.note: 书面语/formal register, common in diplomatic and institutional reporting. Near-synonym contrast: 拖延 (tuōyán, 'to delay/procrastinate') implies avoidance or inefficiency, often personal and mildly negative; 搁置 is deliberate and institutional — a conscious decision to set something aside, often for an indefinite period. Collocations: 搁置争议、搁置计划、被搁置的议题.
cards.tiesTo: Taiwan and AI security explicitly carved out of the Trump-Xi summit outcome, left unresolved

cards.meaning: once… (then) — a connective marking a single triggering event after which a consequence follows, often irreversibly
cards.example: 一旦台湾问题被重新提起，中美关系就可能急转直下。
cards.examplePinyin: Yīdàn Táiwān wèntí bèi chóngxīn tíqǐ, Zhōng-Měi guānxì jiù kěnéng jízhuǎn zhíxià.
cards.exampleMeaning: Once the Taiwan issue is raised again, US-China relations could take a sharp turn for the worse.
cards.note: HSK-4 advanced connective, 书面语/formal register — common in policy and risk analysis. Near-synonym contrast: 如果…就 (rúguǒ…jiù, 'if… then') is a neutral hypothetical that may or may not happen; 一旦…就 implies the triggering event is a real, often sudden or irreversible turning point, with weightier consequences once it occurs. Collocations: 一旦发生、一旦爆发、一旦失控.
cards.tiesTo: The risk that shelved Taiwan tensions could escalate sharply if the issue resurfaces
